content.short: Pods Finance offers an API for embedding DeFi yield, cross-chain swaps and crypto-backed loans.
content.description: Pods Finance exposes DeFi yield, cross-chain swaps and crypto-backed loans through one API, so a product can add them without running any infrastructure. An API key is self-serve and the documentation targets a five-minute integration for the yield endpoints. Routing is cross-chain by default across its supported networks, Monad included.
content.meta: DeFi yield, cross-chain swaps and crypto-backed loans behind a single embeddable API.
